title: Wren and the Atlas
author: Cyrus Brightwater
blurb: Lena Thackeray, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
